name: AG Jeans

prices.note: products.json (2 pages, 261 products): 5 non-jean items excluded, 82 with compare_at above price excluded; 174 regular-price women's jeans at $210–$425. Low end: Farrah Skinny Ankle, Mari, Prima Ankle ($210); high end: Adria and Billie ($425); Mercer and Sydney Selvage at $395.

notes: Homepage title: 'AG Jeans - Official Online Store - Premium Denim Jeans and Clothing'. About page: 'premium denim and knitwear house leading the sustainable manufacturing movement'; founded in Los Angeles in 2000 by Adriano Goldschmied and Yul Ku.

Shipping policy: 'Complimentary 2-day shipping is offered for all online purchases shipping to the U.S.' (contiguous US; no P.O. boxes, APO/FPO or territories) at any subtotal. free_shipping_min_usd left empty because the template would render a $0 threshold as "Over $0". Overnight $14.95–$34.95 by subtotal. Country selector lists Canada, United Kingdom and Australia as shipping countries.

Return policy: 30 days from purchase; $12 return fee (or a $12 restocking fee) unless the $7 Free Returns add-on is bought at checkout; waived for gift card refunds or own-carrier returns. Final Sale not returnable.
production_model detail: Vertically operated with in-house manufacturing; describes itself as the first vertically operated denim manufacturer on the West Coast (About page)
